description: The wrappers' own contract, as opposed to the libraries': 0 valid, 1 invalid, 2 error. The governing rule is that everything about the submitted instance is a verdict and everything about the setup is an error — so an instance that does not parse exits 1, while a schema that does not parse exits 2.

cases.name: a satisfied schema prints VALID and exits 0
an unsatisfied schema prints INVALID and exits 1
an instance that is not JSON is a verdict, not an error
cases.description: A delivered document that fails the JSON grammar has failed validation's lowest tier: a verdict, not an error.

jsonschema-validate: INVALID: instance is not valid JSON: Expecting ',' delimiter: line 1 column 11 (char 10)
ajv-validate: INVALID: instance is not valid JSON: Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 10 (line 1 column 11)

cases.name: a schema that is not JSON is an error

stderrContains.jsonschema-validate: jsonschema-validate: error: schema file {dir}/schema.json is not valid JSON: Expecting value: line 1 column 10 (char 9)
stderrContains.ajv-validate: ajv-validate: error: schema file {dir}/schema.json is not valid JSON: Unexpected end of JSON input

cases.name: a schema that parses but is not a schema is an error

stderrContains.jsonschema-validate: jsonschema-validate: error: {dir}/schema.json is not a valid JSON Schema: 5 is not valid under any of the given schemas
stderrContains.ajv-validate: ajv-validate: error: {dir}/schema.json is not a valid JSON Schema: data/type must be equal to one of the allowed values, data/type must be array, data/type must match a schema in anyOf

cases.name: a missing instance file is an error, not a verdict
cases.description: A file that cannot be read at all is operational, even though it stands where the instance would.

stderrContains.jsonschema-validate: jsonschema-validate: error: instance file not found: {dir}/instance.json
stderrContains.ajv-validate: ajv-validate: error: instance file not found: {dir}/instance.json

cases.name: a missing schema file is an error

stderrContains.jsonschema-validate: jsonschema-validate: error: schema file not found: {dir}/schema.json
stderrContains.ajv-validate: ajv-validate: error: schema file not found: {dir}/schema.json

cases.name: a directory named as the instance is an error

stderrContains.jsonschema-validate: jsonschema-validate: error: instance path is a directory: {dir}/instance.json
stderrContains.ajv-validate: ajv-validate: error: instance path is a directory: {dir}/instance.json

cases.name: a $ref naming nothing the validator holds is an error, not an invalid instance
cases.description: A $ref naming nothing the validator holds. Ajv resolves at compile time and python-jsonschema on first use, but both report it as an error rather than as an invalid instance.

stderrContains.jsonschema-validate: jsonschema-validate: error: {dir}/schema.json contains an unresolvable $ref: PointerToNowhere: '/$defs/absent' does not exist within {'$ref': '#/$defs/absent'}
stderrContains.ajv-validate: ajv-validate: error: {dir}/schema.json is not a valid JSON Schema: can't resolve reference #/$defs/absent from id #
ajv-validate: error: both --schema and --instance are required

cases.name: an option neither wrapper defines is refused
a positional argument is refused rather than read as schema or instance
cases.description: Arguments are named so the schema and instance cannot be transposed; a positional is not accepted as either.

stderrContains.ajv-validate: ajv-validate: error: Unexpected argument '{dir}/schema.json'. This command does not take positional arguments
